text:
Type: black moulded picture frame with mat
Use: displaying a photo or print on a wall or shelf; living room, bedroom, hallway, home office
Style: classic, traditional, contemporary
Materials: moulded frame in a glossy black finish, white mat board, glass front
Colors: black, white mat
Shape: rectangular frame with a rounded, stepped profile moulding, wide white mount around the picture, compact and graphic
Feel: elegant, classic, crisp, timeless
Goes with: black-and-white photos, gallery walls, white or grey walls, dark wood; classic or traditional rooms

product.name: MARIETORP
